name: benchwarmers
description: Benchwarmers: an Alexa+ add-on for watching sports with friends (one-night fantasy draft + live pick'em, by voice).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w server --if-present && npm run build -w web
